description: This file defines base classes for creating commands and syntax version objects in a kickstart configuration parser, including abstract classes for commands, data objects, and handlers.

classes.name: KickstartCommand
classes.description: Abstract base class for all kickstart commands, providing common interface and behavior.

classes.name: DeprecatedCommand
classes.description: Abstract class for deprecated commands that no longer have functionality.

classes.name: RemovedCommand
classes.description: Abstract class for commands that have been removed from the system.

classes.name: KickstartHandler
classes.description: Base class for handling kickstart command parsing and output.

classes.name: BaseHandler
classes.description: Abstract class for specific versioned kickstart syntax handlers.

classes.name: BaseData
classes.description: Abstract base class for all data objects used within kickstart commands.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for classes, initializing attributes and enforcing abstract class constraints.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Abstract method to parse command arguments; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns list of data objects for commands that can occur multiple times.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Returns class used to store data for commands that can occur multiple times.

methods.name: deleteRemovedAttrs
methods.description: Removes attributes listed in removedAttrs from the object.

methods.name: set_to_self
methods.description: Sets attributes from an argparse.Namespace object onto the command object.

methods.name: set_to_obj
methods.description: Sets attributes from an argparse.Namespace object onto a specified object.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Sets multiple attributes on the object via keyword arguments.
